description: Bikram Sambat (Nepali) <-> Gregorian date conversion with weekday, Nepali month names, Devanagari digits and Nepal fiscal year. Use for any Nepali (BS / Bikram Sambat / Vikram Samvat) date: converting to or from AD, finding the weekday, writing it in Nepali, or finding the Nepal fiscal year. Models often get BS dates wrong; this is an exact table (1970-2090 BS). Returns bs {iso, text, textNe, monthName, daysInMonth}, ad {iso}, weekday, weekdayNe, fiscalYear and isSaturday. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.
